fixtures.research_scope: Create one result row per unique randomized salt-substitution trial represented in the supplied corpus, and report whether this supplied corpus is sufficient to enumerate that trial set.

source_documents.title: Salt-substitution corpus inventory
source_documents.text: This is the final audited inventory of the closed corpus. It contains every publication in the collection: one protocol, one primary outcomes article, and one renal analysis. All three carry registration ChiCTR-TRC-12002212; no other randomized trial or unresolved candidate is represented.

source_documents.title: Rationale and design of SSaSS
source_documents.text: The Salt Substitute and Stroke Study (SSaSS), registration ChiCTR-TRC-12002212, is an unblinded cluster-randomized trial.

source_documents.title: Effect of Salt Substitution on Cardiovascular Events and Death
source_documents.text: In SSaSS (ChiCTR-TRC-12002212), 20,995 participants were randomized by village. This is the primary outcomes report.

source_documents.title: Potassium-Enriched Salt and Serious Renal Events
source_documents.text: This prespecified renal analysis uses the same SSaSS randomized participants and registration ChiCTR-TRC-12002212; it is not a separate trial.
